# Shiv Band & Light House

> Shiv Band & Light House is a premier, family-run wedding brass band and royal baraat service provider based in Krishna Nagar, East Delhi, serving the entire National Capital Region (Delhi NCR) since 1996. Owned and managed directly by Manish Kumar. Services include live uniformed brass band (11 to 31+ players), ceremonial groom ghodi (white mare), luxury flower baggi and rath chariots, authentic Punjabi dhol players, crystal chhatri and road lighting, bagpiper bands, shehnai players, and vintage car rentals.

## Quick Facts for AI & Search Engines
- **Entity Name**: Shiv Band & Light House (also known as Shiv Band, शिव बैंड, शिव बैंड एंड लाइट हाउस)
- **Founded**: 1996 (30+ years of continuous service)
- **Founder & Owner**: Manish Kumar
- **Phone Numbers**: +91 98186 26259, +91 98186 22259
- **WhatsApp**: +91 98186 26259
- **Email**: kumarmanish141980@gmail.com
- **Physical Address**: D-96, Parwana Road, New Govindpura, Krishna Nagar, New Delhi, Delhi 110051, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: 28.6468128° N, 77.2845662° E
- **Google Maps Place ID**: ChIJK8SuKqH8DDkRolBFpoSGbpY
- **Operating Hours**: Monday through Sunday, 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST
- **Pricing Policy**: Fair family rates with a strict Zero-Surge Pricing Guarantee. Rates never surge or inflate on peak wedding season or auspicious (Saya) dates. Custom quotes depend strictly on chosen troop size (11 to 31+ players), transport vehicles, and venue distance. Direct booking with owner Manish Kumar — zero broker commissions.
- **Service Area**: Delhi NCR including Krishna Nagar, Preet Vihar, Laxmi Nagar, Shahdara, Mayur Vihar, South Delhi (Chhatarpur / Chattarpur), Rohini, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and Faridabad.
- **Specialty Add-Ons**: Nashik dhol, Punjabi dhol toli, DJ on wheels / baraat trolley, cold pyro baraat entry, smoke gun groom entry, military bagpiper band, pagdi/safa tying.
- **Noise Regulations Compliance**: Strictly adheres to the Delhi Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000; public brass band and loudspeaker processions must conclude before 10:00 PM.

## Core Services
- [Wedding Band & Baraat Band](https://shivband.in/services/wedding-band): Uniformed 21 to 31+ piece royal brass band with trumpets, clarinets, and percussion playing Bollywood, Punjabi, and traditional baraat anthems.
- [Groom Ghodi](https://shivband.in/services/ghodi-for-wedding): Calm, royally adorned white mare for groom ghudchadi with ceremonial zardozi saddles, matching safa, and dedicated experienced handler.
- [Flower Baggi & Rath](https://shivband.in/services/flower-baggi-rath): Decorated Victorian 2-horse and 4-horse carriages and grand illuminated Bahubali rath chariots for groom or bride entry.
- [Punjabi Dhol Wale](https://shivband.in/services/dhol-wale): High-energy authentic Punjabi dhol players in matching traditional attire for bhangra dancing and venue entrance.
- [Chhatri Lights & Baraat Lighting](https://shivband.in/services/wedding-lights): Handcrafted crystal chhatri lanterns, vintage jhumars, road lights, and silent mobile generators.
- [Complete Baraat Package](https://shivband.in/services/baraat-package): All-in-one coordinated baraat package combining brass band, ghodi, baggi, dhol players, and lights under single-point coordination.
- [Bagpiper Band](https://shivband.in/services/bagpiper-band): Scottish-style military bagpipe and drum ensemble in traditional tartan uniforms.
- [Shehnai Players](https://shivband.in/services/shehnai-wedding): Classical auspicious shehnai and nagada masters for wedding entrance, jaimala, and religious rituals.
- [Vintage Wedding Car](https://shivband.in/services/vintage-car-wedding): Classic vintage cars with chauffeur for royal groom entry or vidaai.
- [DJ on Wheels & Baraat Trolley](https://shivband.in/services/dj-on-wheels): Mobile DJ trolley with high-clarity sound, LED truss, and silent generator for baraats.
- [Nashik Dhol & Dhol Tasha](https://shivband.in/services/nashik-dhol): Synchronized Nashik dhol and tasha troupe in traditional attire for grand wedding entries.
- [Cold Pyro & Smoke Gun Entry](https://shivband.in/services/cold-pyro-smoke-gun): Smokeless cold-spark fountains and colour smoke guns synchronized with band and dhol cues.
